items.sentence: One rare blue butterfly landed on the garden gate.
Doctors hear the patient's heart beat steadily through a stethoscope.
Today, the sleepy cat seemed indifferent to the noisy parade.
Today, the tailor will sew a button onto the coat.
Today, the vet used an antibiotic to help the kitten heal.
Today, the old tree had a chronic lean toward the pond.
Today, an eagle has amazing sight from very high above.
A plant disease became fatal after its leaves turned brown.
Today, leaves tremble whenever a soft wind passes the branch.
A nurse brings warm soup to the recovering patient.
